summary: YPF Sociedad Anónima filed a Form 6-K reporting that it repurchased Class XXX Notes between June 16-19, 2026, for an aggregate purchase price of Ps. 33,729,032,772.70 (par value equivalent of US$23,213,627). These notes were originally issued in July 2024 and April 2025 under YPF's Frequent Issuer framework, with a July 2026 maturity. The repurchase price averaged 99.96% of nominal value. This debt buyback is an ordinary capital management action, not a transformative event such as a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The repurchased notes will be held in portfolio. There is no special-situation catalyst or risk-arb angle. It is routine liability management.
